Class GTNetEnvelopeValidator

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.gtnet.GTNetEnvelopeValidator
@Component public class GTNetEnvelopeValidator extends Object
The bounds of an inbound envelope that Bean Validation cannot express.

Field-level lengths are declared on MessageEnvelope itself, but the enforcement lives here: how many parameters the envelope carries, how large the serialized payload is, how far its timestamp lies from our clock, whether the correlation fields match the category of the code, and which fields are mandatory for that code at all. All of it is checked before status synchronization, budget charging and persistence, so a violation is a protocol rejection rather than an HTTP 500 out of the persistence layer.

      public Optional<GTNetEnvelopeValidator.EnvelopeViolation> validate(MessageEnvelope me, GTNet remoteGTNet)
      Checks the envelope against the protocol limits and the correlation rules of its code.
      Parameters:
      me - the received envelope
      remoteGTNet - the local entry of the sending peer, null when the peer is not known yet (first handshake)
      Returns:
      the violation as a stable errorMsgCode and a human-readable reason, empty when the envelope is acceptable
